a.xlink:title: Opens the server's main database connection; false when it cannot be opened.
Whether the backing store is reachable, reconnecting when it is not.
Append a moderator/admin action to the server audit log.
Record a ban; the caller proceeds even when the insert fails, as before.
Records a forgot-password request for the user.
Stores a new open report, returning whether the insert succeeded.
Deletes all expired share bundles (cascades to their items).
Drop the account's legacy password backup.
Comments the author wrote in the last hour, for the hourly cap.
Reports the reporter submitted in the last day, for the daily cap.
Creates a new temporary deck share bundle.
Deletes a delivered activation e-mail queue row; false when the statement fails.
Deletes one of a user's own share bundles (cascades to its items).
Whether an unexpired forgot-password request exists for the user.
Every SQL-configured room for one server, in id order; empty when the query fails.
Id and color identity of every deck file in a folder, for the share builder.
Fetches the content of one item of a valid share bundle.
Looks up a valid (non-expired) share bundle by token.
Share bundles the user created in the last day, or -1 when the read failed.
Lists the share bundles created by a user, newest first.
The newest server message for the login banner; false when the lookup fails or finds no row.
Freshest uptime snapshot of one server; an invalid snapshot when none exists.
